walkthrough: Goal: as s163-replay, in Chinese: watch the picture come about again stroke by stroke, then go back to drawing as if nothing happened.
Before: the same canvas: a closed shape and a wave, colour dropped into the shape, Layer 2 with two strokes.
Entry: 操作 (Actions); under 分享, after 分享 JPEG…, 回放… after a play icon with '4 笔' quiet at its right.

Open: a tap and the replay takes the screen from blank paper at 4x: 返回 at the top left, 导出视频… at the top right, the bar along the bottom with 暂停 in its ring, the track, over it '10月5日 12:00 · 第 1 笔' (no space inside the date) and the time, and 1x 4x 16x.
Gestures: 暂停 stops it (播放 again); a tap on the track goes there; a speed changes the pace at once. The pen and fingers on the canvas do nothing.

Close: 返回 (or the system's back): the studio as it was, the artwork the same to the pixel. Undo: 撤销 undoes the last stroke drawn before the replay. Failure: none. Reopen: the same replay, the strokes with their days and times.
